game.core.world.fact.summary: Occasional rune-enchanted items perform specific magical functions and are the practical magic people are most likely to encounter. They are costly, specialized, and maintained like valuable tools; a wealthy inn might own a rune-worked cold or freezer box, but rune tools do not make magic an everyday industrial technology.
game.core.world.fact.provenance: User-established worldbuilding constraint; recorded and clarified by Codex (2026-08-22).
